requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Phased-array and beamforming signal processing: developed the simulation and verification environment for Kajanti's 8-element phased-array receiver, including beam-pattern prediction, sidelobe-level analysis, and array-calibration verification against specification

requirements.note: Text describes building a simulation/verification environment for the phased-array receiver rather than explicitly describing design or implementation of the operational beamforming algorithm itself; quoted as stated.

lines.quote: over the past two years I have been writing embedded DSP routines in C for a new Kajanti product line. The work involves real-time digital filtering on an ARM Cortex-A9 target, integrating the embedded code with the existing processing chain, and verifying output against my MATLAB reference models.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: M.Sc. Industrial Engineering and Management, Roslagen Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, 2007

requirements.note: Degree is in Industrial Engineering and Management, not electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics; field-adjacency to the role is a judgement call for the recruiter, not resolved here.

lines.quote: Swedish citizen; full EU/EEA freedom of movement and unrestricted right to work in Finland.
All work conducted in English as Kajanti's corporate language. Technical reports, design specifications, and test documentation authored in English throughout my career here.
Based in Oulu, where Kajanti's main office is located.
